ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Weekly virtual class sessions in Elluminate course delivery system. Two Saturday labs on the Urbana campus on Apr. 2 and Apr. 16 from 10 am to 3 pm. One field trip during a weekday by arrangement. No class March 21 and 28 and April 11. No Textbook. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $343.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
